title: Plan Scope Selector
description: A set of stations, markets and programming formats, used by planning_goals.must_include and must_exclude. At least one member is required. Unlike targeting_overlay, which restricts where a package may deliver, a must_include entry asks that the plan contain the named inventory and a must_exclude entry that it contain none of it.

stations.description: Stations by identifier (station_id or facility_id). Each entry is one identifier; a station with several identifiers is named by any one of them.

markets.description: Markets as metro selections, in the same shape as targeting_overlay.geo_metros.

programming_formats.description: Programming formats by the seller's code, as listed on a plan_breakdown row of dimension programming_format.
